summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company, reporting the completion of its migration to the Novo Mercado, B3's highest corporate governance segment. The filing contains no transaction details, no price or stake, no board recommendation, and no special-situation event. It is a standard governance upgrade announcement. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 with no M&A, activist, or restructuring content, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
